name: All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce
author: Techiesaround

sections.description:
Take your WooCommerce store to the next level with All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce Plugin – your ultimate solution for seamless integration with Google Sheets! Effortlessly synchronize key elements like Orders, Product Inventory Details, and Customers into a centralized Google Spreadsheet.

Say goodbye to manual updates and streamline your data management with real-time synchronization!

Google API Integration

This plugin leverages Google APIs to deliver powerful features:
– Read and write data to Google Sheets
– Handle OAuth authentication for secure access to Google services

Features List for All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce Plugin

1. Google Credentials Configuration

  • Quickly configure your Google account credentials for smooth integration.

2. Stock Updates from Google Spreadsheet

  • Update WooCommerce product stock levels directly from a connected Google Spreadsheet.

3. Order Synchronization

  • Automatically sync WooCommerce sales orders to a Google Spreadsheet.
  • Supports syncing based on these order statuses:
    • New Order Placement
    • After Payment Completion
    • Processing Order
    • Order Completion

4. Customer Data Synchronization

  • Export customer details from WooCommerce to a designated Google Spreadsheet.

5. Debug and Log Data Transfers

  • Enable debug mode to log data transfer activities for troubleshooting and monitoring.

Links for Additional Resources

Enhance your experience with All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce using the following resources:

  • Calendly Support Link: Schedule a Call
    Need help? Book a one-on-one session to get support or resolve queries.

  • Sample Sheets: View Sample Sheets
    Check out our sample sheets to understand how data syncing works.

  • Product Page: Visit Product Page
    Learn more about the plugin, its features, and updates.

  • Configuration Guide: Configuration Details
    Step-by-step instructions to configure and set up the plugin.

  • Video Tutorial: Watch Video Guide
    A comprehensive video tutorial to help you get started quickly.

Why Choose All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce?

This plugin bridges WooCommerce with Google Spreadsheets, enabling real-time data synchronization for better inventory and order management.
Integration is done with Google’s most up-to-date and secure libraries, ensuring maximum reliability and safety for your data. Perfect for store owners who value efficiency and accuracy!

Ready to Simplify Your Workflow?

Download the All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce Plugin today and experience effortless data management!

Third-Party Services Used

This plugin communicates with the following external Google services:

  1. Google Sheets API: Used to retrieve and append data to Google Sheets. Data such as spreadsheet IDs and content is sent to Google Sheets via API requests.

    • Service Documentation: https://developers.google.com/sheets/api
    • Terms of Use: https://developers.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  2. Google Drive API: Used to upload and retrieve files from Google Drive.

    • Service Documentation: https://developers.google.com/drive/api
    • Terms of Use: https://developers.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  3. Google OAuth 2.0: Used for user authentication and authorization of Google services.

    • Service Documentation: https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2
    • Terms of Use: https://developers.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

By using this plugin, users are subject to the terms and privacy policies of these external services.

Legal

Please ensure that using these services is compliant with local data protection laws and regulations, as data may be transmitted to Google servers when using this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via WordPress Plugin Directory or manually upload it to your site.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings and configure your Google API credentials.
  4. Follow the instructions in the settings to connect your WooCommerce store with Google Sheets.
sections.faq:
What is All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce?

All-in-One GSheetSync for WooCommerce is a plugin that integrates your WooCommerce store with Google Spreadsheets, allowing real-time synchronization of orders, product inventory, and customer data.

Can I update WooCommerce stock levels using a Google Spreadsheet?

Yes, the plugin allows you to update WooCommerce product stock levels directly from a connected Google Spreadsheet.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Added support for renamed sheets in Google Spreadsheets:
    • Previously supported only “Sheet1”; now supports renamed sheets.
  • Multi-sheet support:
    • Users can now select multiple sheets within a single spreadsheet for synchronization.
  • Enhanced order module functionality:
    • Product name, quantity, and price can now be added to orders.

1.0.1

  • Added three new screenshots:
    • Import product inventory data.
    • Order synchronization with Google Spreadsheet.
    • Customer data export to Google Spreadsheet.
  • Included product-related links for better user experience:
    • Added video tutorial link for quick setup guidance.
    • Provided links to sample sheets for configuration references.
    • Added configuration page link for seamless setup.
    • Integrated Calendly link for scheduling support.
    • Included a product page link.

1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Support for Google Sheets integration.
  • Sync WooCommerce orders, inventory, and customer details.
